title: plan.json
description: Reference, not enforcement: nothing loads this file, `load_plan` is a bare `json.loads`. It documents the desired folder structure as a flat, ordered node list. Flat because a diff must be readable and because `add` is a single append: that is what makes bootstrap and new-area the same code.

path.description: Slash-separated, relative to the repo root. The folder is created at this path.

role.description: router: has children with their own CLAUDE.md, points down only. leaf: fat context, full section skeleton. plain: ambient folder, no CLAUDE.md.

title.description: Display name. Fills {{NODE_TITLE}} and the folder map row.

children.description: Sub-folder names scaffolded under this node, each with a .gitkeep.

template.description: Basename of a file in .workspace/templates/, without the .md.

files.description: Files rendered into the node's folder at scaffold time.

gitkeep.description: Put a .gitkeep in the node's own folder, so an empty ambient folder survives a clone.

instanceRole.description: The role each child instance gets when `add` appends one under this node.

instanceTemplate.description: Marks this node as a parent instances are added under. Only its presence is read; `new-area` uses it to infer the parent from a name without asking.

purpose.description: One line saying what the node is for. Fills {{NODE_PURPOSE}} and the README of a plain folder.
